<thought>We need the number of chemically equivalent carbon atoms (unique carbon environments). The best way is to obtain the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample, which will show distinct peaks corresponding to each unique carbon environment. We'll use the carbon_nmr_spectra tool to get the spectrum, then count the distinct peaks.</thought>
